WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT DATE(orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS sale_date, COUNT(order_items.order_id) AS toy_sales
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE orders.order_purchase_timestamp BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY sale_date
),
indexed_sales AS (
    SELECT sale_date, toy_sales,
           JULIANDAY(sale_date) - JULIANDAY('2017-01-01') AS day_index
    FROM daily_sales
),
coefficients AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        AVG(day_index) AS avg_x,
        AVG(toy_sales) AS avg_y,
        AVG(day_index * toy_sales) AS avg_xy,
        AVG(day_index * day_index) AS avg_xx
    FROM indexed_sales
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        (avg_xy - avg_x * avg_y) / (avg_xx - avg_x * avg_x) AS slope,
        avg_y - ((avg_xy - avg_x * avg_y) / (avg_xx - avg_x * avg_x)) * avg_x AS intercept
    FROM coefficients
),

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, op.payment_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_rfm_base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
        COUNT(order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(payment_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
recency_calculation AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        last_purchase,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        julianday('now') - julianday(last_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_rfm_base
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS recency_score,  -- 1 is very recent
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS frequency_score,    -- 1 is most frequent
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS monetary_score     -- 1 is highest spending
    FROM recency_calculation
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        recency_score,
        frequency_score,
        monetary_score,
        (frequency_score + monetary_score) AS freq_monetary_sum,
        CASE
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN recency_score IN (4, 5) AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Cant Lose Them'
            WHEN recency_score IN (4, 5) AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN recency_score IN (4, 5) AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN recency_score IN (2, 3) AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN recency_score = 3 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (recency_score = 1 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR 
                 (recency_score = 2 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN recency_score = 2 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN recency_score = 3 AND frequency_score + monetary_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores
),
avg_sales_per_order AS (
    SELECT
        do.customer_id,
        SUM(do.payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT do.order_id) AS avg_sales
    FROM delivered_orders do
    GROUP BY do.customer_id
)

SELECT
    s.rfm_segment,
    AVG(a.avg_sales) AS avg_sales_per_order_avg,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers_count
FROM rfm_segments s
JOIN avg_sales_per_order a ON s.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY s.rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order_avg DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH customer_payments AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS number_of_orders,
    AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order_date
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_lifespans AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    number_of_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE
      WHEN (julianday(last_order_date) - julianday(first_order_date))/7 < 1 THEN 1.0
      ELSE (julianday(last_order_date) - julianday(first_order_date))/7
    END AS lifespan_in_weeks
  FROM customer_payments
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  number_of_orders,
  avg_payment_per_order,
  lifespan_in_weeks
FROM customer_lifespans
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH player_career_span AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y', final_game) - STRFTIME('%Y', debut) AS years_diff,
    STRFTIME('%m', final_game) - STRFTIME('%m', debut) AS months_diff,
    STRFTIME('%d', final_game) - STRFTIME('%d', debut) AS days_diff
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
), career_span_calc AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(years_diff), 2) AS years_part,
    ROUND(ABS(months_diff) / 12.0, 2) AS months_part,
    ROUND(ABS(days_diff) / 365.0, 2) AS days_part
  FROM player_career_span
), career_span_sum AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    years_part + months_part + days_part AS total_career_span
  FROM career_span_calc
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_career_span), 2) AS avg_career_span_years
FROM career_span_sum;

WITH max_values AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(g) AS max_games,
    MAX(r) AS max_runs,
    MAX(h) AS max_hits,
    MAX(hr) AS max_home_runs
  FROM batting
),
players_max_stats AS (
  SELECT p.name_given, b.g, b.r, b.h, b.hr
  FROM batting b
  JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE b.g = (SELECT max_games FROM max_values)
    OR b.r = (SELECT max_runs FROM max_values)
    OR b.h = (SELECT max_hits FROM max_values)
    OR b.hr = (SELECT max_home_runs FROM max_values)
)
SELECT DISTINCT name_given, g, r, h, hr
FROM players_max_stats;

WITH CityCoords AS (
  SELECT airport_code, 
         CAST(json_extract(city, '$.en') AS TEXT) AS city_en,
         CAST(substr(coordinates, 2, instr(coordinates, ',') - 2) AS REAL) AS latitude,
         CAST(substr(coordinates, instr(coordinates, ',') + 1, length(coordinates) - instr(coordinates, ',') - 1) AS REAL) AS longitude
  FROM airports_data
),
AbakanAirports AS (
  SELECT airport_code 
  FROM CityCoords 
  WHERE city_en = 'Abakan'
),
FlightPairs AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport,
    cc1.city_en AS city1,
    cc2.city_en AS city2,
    cc1.latitude AS lat1,
    cc1.longitude AS lon1,
    cc2.latitude AS lat2,
    cc2.longitude AS lon2
  FROM flights f
  JOIN CityCoords cc1 ON f.departure_airport = cc1.airport_code
  JOIN CityCoords cc2 ON f.arrival_airport = cc2.airport_code
  WHERE f.departure_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM AbakanAirports) 
     OR f.arrival_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM AbakanAirports)
),
Distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2) +
        COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) *
        POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM FlightPairs
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS max_distance_km FROM Distances;

WITH city_coordinates AS (
  SELECT 
    ap.airport_code,
    CAST(ap.city AS TEXT) AS city,
    CAST(substr(ap.coordinates, 1, instr(ap.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS FLOAT) AS longitude,
    CAST(substr(ap.coordinates, instr(ap.coordinates, ',') + 1) AS FLOAT) AS latitude
  FROM airports_data ap
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN cc1.city < cc2.city THEN cc1.city ELSE cc2.city END AS city1,
    CASE WHEN cc1.city < cc2.city THEN cc2.city ELSE cc1.city END AS city2,
    cc1.latitude AS lat1,
    cc1.longitude AS long1,
    cc2.latitude AS lat2,
    cc2.longitude AS long2
  FROM flights f
  JOIN city_coordinates cc1 ON f.departure_airport = cc1.airport_code
  JOIN city_coordinates cc2 ON f.arrival_airport = cc2.airport_code
),
calculated_distances AS (
  SELECT
    city1,
    city2,
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((RADIANS(lat2 - lat1)) / 2), 2) +
        COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) * POWER(SIN((RADIANS(long2 - long1)) / 2), 2)
      )
    ) AS distance
  FROM city_pairs
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT city1, city2, AVG(distance) AS avg_distance
  FROM calculated_distances
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distance_ranges AS (
  SELECT avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END AS distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
),
count_by_range AS (
  SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) AS pair_count
  FROM distance_ranges
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT pair_count
FROM count_by_range
ORDER BY pair_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CollisionHelmetInfo AS (
  SELECT
    c.case_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_helmet
  FROM collisions c
  LEFT JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
  WHERE p.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle'
  GROUP BY c.case_id
), FatalitiesByHelmet AS (
  SELECT
    chi.has_helmet AS has_helmet,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.case_id) AS fatalities
  FROM CollisionHelmetInfo chi
  LEFT JOIN victims v ON chi.case_id = v.case_id AND v.victim_role = 'motorcyclist' AND v.victim_degree_of_injury = 'fatal'
  GROUP BY chi.has_helmet
), TotalCollisionsByHelmet AS (
  SELECT
    has_helmet AS has_helmet,
    COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS total_collisions
  FROM CollisionHelmetInfo
  GROUP BY has_helmet
)
SELECT
  CASE f.has_helmet
    WHEN 1 THEN 'helmet_worn'
    WHEN 0 THEN 'no_helmet'
  END AS helmet_usage_group,
  100.0 * CAST(f.fatalities AS FLOAT) / t.total_collisions AS fatality_rate
FROM FatalitiesByHelmet f
JOIN TotalCollisionsByHelmet t ON f.has_helmet = t.has_helmet
ORDER BY helmet_usage_group;

WITH CauseCountsByYear AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collisions.collision_date) AS year,
    collisions.primary_collision_factor AS cause,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, collisions.primary_collision_factor
),
TopCausesByYear AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    cause,
    count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count DESC) AS cause_rank
  FROM CauseCountsByYear
  WHERE cause IS NOT NULL
),
YearTop2Causes AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    cause
  FROM TopCausesByYear
  WHERE cause_rank <= 2
),
YearTop2CauseString AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    GROUP_CONCAT(cause, ',') AS causes
  FROM YearTop2Causes
  GROUP BY year
),
MostCommonCauseString AS (
  SELECT
    causes,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM YearTop2CauseString
  GROUP BY causes
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
YearsWithDiffCauses AS (
  SELECT
    year
  FROM YearTop2CauseString
  WHERE causes != (SELECT causes FROM MostCommonCauseString)
)
SELECT year
FROM YearsWithDiffCauses;

WITH collision_factors_2011 AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor, COUNT(*) AS count_2011
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2011'
  GROUP BY primary_collision_factor
),
collision_factors_2021 AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor, COUNT(*) AS count_2021
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2021'
  GROUP BY primary_collision_factor
),
total_2011 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_2011
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2011'
),
total_2021 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_2021
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2021'
),
most_common_factor_2021 AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor
  FROM collision_factors_2021
  ORDER BY count_2021 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
  (100.0 * cf2021.count_2021 / t2021.total_2021) - (100.0 * cf2011.count_2011 / t2011.total_2011) AS percentage_point_diff
FROM most_common_factor_2021 mcf
JOIN collision_factors_2021 cf2021 ON mcf.primary_collision_factor = cf2021.primary_collision_factor
JOIN collision_factors_2011 cf2011 ON mcf.primary_collision_factor = cf2011.primary_collision_factor
CROSS JOIN total_2011 t2011
CROSS JOIN total_2021 t2021
;

WITH nxt_matches AS (

  FROM Matches m

  JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id

WITH bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ball_by_ball.bowler AS bowler_id,
        COUNT(wicket_taken.player_out) AS wickets,
        SUM(batsman_scored.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken ON ball_by_ball.match_id = wicket_taken.match_id
                             AND ball_by_ball.over_id = wicket_taken.over_id
                             AND ball_by_ball.ball_id = wicket_taken.ball_id
    JOIN batsman_scored ON ball_by_ball.match_id = batsman_scored.match_id
                        AND ball_by_ball.over_id = batsman_scored.over_id
                        AND ball_by_ball.ball_id = batsman_scored.ball_id
    WHERE ball_by_ball.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ball_by_ball.bowler
)
SELECT player.player_name, (runs_conceded * 1.0 / wickets) AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_stats
JOIN player ON bowler_stats.bowler_id = player.player_id
WHERE wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH OverRuns AS (
    SELECT
      b.match_id,
      b.innings_no,
      b.over_id,
      SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS batsman_runs,
      SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS extra_runs
    FROM
      ball_by_ball b
      LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
      LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id
    GROUP BY
      b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
), MaxOverRuns AS (
    SELECT
      match_id, innings_no, over_id, batsman_runs + extra_runs AS total_runs
    FROM
      OverRuns
    WHERE
      (match_id, innings_no, batsman_runs + extra_runs) IN (
        SELECT
          match_id, innings_no, MAX(batsman_runs + extra_runs)
        FROM
          OverRuns
        GROUP BY
          match_id, innings_no
      )
), MaxBowler AS (
    SELECT
      mor.match_id, mor.innings_no, mor.over_id, mor.total_runs, b.bowler
    FROM
      MaxOverRuns mor
      JOIN ball_by_ball b ON b.match_id = mor.match_id AND b.innings_no = mor.innings_no AND b.over_id = mor.over_id
    GROUP BY
      mor.match_id, mor.innings_no, mor.over_id, mor.total_runs, b.bowler
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_runs) AS avg_highest_run_over
FROM
  MaxBowler;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) AS year, strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date) AS month
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
)
SELECT month,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN year = '2016' THEN order_id END) AS "2016",
       COUNT(CASE WHEN year = '2017' THEN order_id END) AS "2017",
       COUNT(CASE WHEN year = '2018' THEN order_id END) AS "2018"
FROM delivered_orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

    SELECT o.customer_id, AVG(p.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value

WITH city_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip
  FROM olist_geolocation
), distance_calc AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    prev_zip,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    prev_lat,
    prev_lng,
    RADIANS(geolocation_lat) AS lat2,
    RADIANS(geolocation_lng) AS lon2,
    RADIANS(prev_lat) AS lat1,
    RADIANS(prev_lng) AS lon1
  FROM city_ordered
  WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL
), distances AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    prev_zip,
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(lat1) * COS(lat2) * COS(lon2 - lon1) + SIN(lat1) * SIN(lat2)
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM distance_calc
)
SELECT
  prev_state AS state_1,
  prev_city AS city_1,
  prev_zip AS zip_1,
  geolocation_state AS state_2,
  geolocation_city AS city_2,
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_2,
  distance_km
FROM distances
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

customer_spending AS (

WITH ArtistSales AS (
    SELECT
        ar.artistid,

    JOIN tracks t ON al.albumid = t.albumid

    GROUP BY ar.artistid, ar.name
),

RankedArtists AS (

        artistid,

        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales ASC, artist_name ASC) AS rank_bottom
    FROM ArtistSales
),

TargetArtists AS (
    SELECT artistid, artist_name, total_sales FROM RankedArtists WHERE rank_top = 1 OR rank_bottom = 1
),

CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT

    JOIN invoice_items ii ON iv.invoiceid = ii.invoiceid
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.trackid = t.trackid
    JOIN albums al ON t.albumid = al.albumid

    GROUP BY c.customerid, ta.artist_name

AvgSpending AS (

TopArtist AS (

BottomArtist AS (

)

WITH usa_sales AS (
  SELECT
    cu.cust_city AS city,
    s.prod_id AS product_id,
    t.calendar_year AS year,
    t.calendar_quarter_number AS quarter,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  WHERE cu.country_id = (SELECT country_id FROM countries WHERE country_name = 'United States')
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND s.promo_id = 0
  GROUP BY cu.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
city_growth AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2020,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN
      SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sales_growth
  FROM usa_sales
  GROUP BY city
  HAVING sales_growth >= 1.2
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT s.city, s.product_id, s.year, s.quarter, s.total_sales
  FROM usa_sales s
  JOIN city_growth cg ON s.city = cg.city
  WHERE s.year IN (2019, 2020) AND s.quarter = 4
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    product_id,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_all_quarters,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY SUM(total_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS product_count
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY city, product_id
),
filtered_top_products AS (
  SELECT city, product_id, total_sales_all_quarters
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE sales_rank <= CEIL(product_count * 0.2)
),
product_annual_sales AS (
  SELECT
    f.city, f.product_id, f.year, f.quarter, f.total_sales
  FROM filtered_sales f
  JOIN filtered_top_products ftp ON f.city = ftp.city AND f.product_id = ftp.product_id
),
product_city_year_total AS (
  SELECT
    city, year, SUM(total_sales) AS city_year_total_sales
  FROM usa_sales
  WHERE city IN (SELECT city FROM city_growth)
    AND year IN (2019, 2020)
  GROUP BY city, year
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT
    p.city,
    p.product_id,
    p.year,
    p.total_sales,
    (p.total_sales * 1.0) / c.city_year_total_sales AS sales_share
  FROM product_annual_sales p
  JOIN product_city_year_total c ON p.city = c.city AND p.year = c.year
  WHERE p.quarter = 4
),
share_changes AS (
  SELECT
    p2019.city,
    p2019.product_id,
    p2019.sales_share AS share_2019,
    p2020.sales_share AS share_2020,
    (p2020.sales_share - p2019.sales_share) AS share_change
  FROM product_share p2019
  JOIN product_share p2020 ON p2019.city = p2020.city AND p2019.product_id = p2020.product_id AND p2020.year = 2020
  WHERE p2019.year = 2019
)

SELECT city, product_id, share_2019, share_2020, share_change
FROM share_changes
ORDER BY share_change DESC
;

extreme_months AS (

WITH city_dates AS (

WITH jan_data AS (

  FROM cities ci
  JOIN cities_countries cc ON ci.country_code_2 = cc.country_code_2
  WHERE ci.insert_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-01-31'
),

country_9_days AS (
  SELECT country_id
  FROM jan_data
  GROUP BY country_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT insert_date) = 9
),

country_dates AS (
  SELECT country_id, insert_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_id ORDER BY insert_date) AS rn
  FROM jan_data
  WHERE country_id IN (SELECT country_id FROM country_9_days)
),

consecutive_periods AS (
  SELECT country_id, insert_date, rn,
    DATE(insert_date, '-' || rn || ' day') AS group_id
  FROM country_dates
),

grouped_periods AS (
  SELECT country_id, group_id, MIN(insert_date) AS start_date, MAX(insert_date) AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_days
  FROM consecutive_periods
  GROUP BY country_id, group_id
),

longest_period AS (
  SELECT country_id, start_date, end_date, consecutive_days
  FROM grouped_periods
  ORDER BY consecutive_days DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

entries_in_longest_period AS (
  SELECT jd.*
  FROM jan_data jd
  JOIN longest_period lp ON jd.country_id = lp.country_id
  WHERE jd.insert_date BETWEEN lp.start_date AND lp.end_date
),

result AS (
  SELECT lp.country_id, lp.start_date, lp.end_date, lp.consecutive_days,
    COUNT(eilp.city_id) AS total_entries,
    SUM(CASE WHEN eilp.capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS capital_entries,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN eilp.capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(eilp.city_id), 4) AS capital_proportion
  FROM longest_period lp
  LEFT JOIN entries_in_longest_period eilp ON lp.country_id = eilp.country_id
  GROUP BY lp.country_id, lp.start_date, lp.end_date, lp.consecutive_days
)

SELECT country_id, start_date, end_date, consecutive_days, total_entries, capital_entries, capital_proportion
FROM result;

customer_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, month_start
  FROM customer_transactions
  CROSS JOIN month_series 
  WHERE month_start <= date('now', 'start of month')
),
monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.month_start,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT sum(txn_amount)
       FROM customer_transactions ct
       WHERE ct.customer_id = cm.customer_id
         AND date(ct.txn_date) <= date(cm.month_start, '+1 month', '-1 day')
      ),
      0
    ) AS closing_balance
  FROM customer_months cm
),
monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    closing_balance,
    closing_balance - LAG(closing_balance, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS monthly_change
  FROM monthly_balances
),
cumulative_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    closing_balance,
    monthly_change,
    SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_balance
  FROM monthly_changes
)
SELECT * FROM cumulative_balances
ORDER BY customer_id, month_start;

WITH event_type_map AS (
    SELECT event_type, event_name FROM shopping_cart_event_identifier
), filtered_events AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, e.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
), event_names AS (
    SELECT f.product_id, m.event_name
    FROM filtered_events f
    JOIN event_type_map m ON f.event_type = m.event_type
), purchase_events AS (
    SELECT p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    JOIN event_type_map m ON e.event_type = m.event_type
    WHERE m.event_name = 'purchase'
      AND e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
), view_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count
    FROM event_names
    WHERE event_name = 'view'
    GROUP BY product_id
), add_to_cart_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS add_to_cart_count
    FROM event_names
    WHERE event_name = 'add_to_cart'
    GROUP BY product_id
), left_in_cart_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS left_in_cart_count
    FROM event_names
    WHERE event_name = 'left_in_cart'
    GROUP BY product_id
), purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM purchase_events
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(add_to_cart_count, 0) AS add_to_cart_count,
    COALESCE(left_in_cart_count, 0) AS left_in_cart_count,
    COALESCE(purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM view_counts v
LEFT JOIN add_to_cart_counts a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN left_in_cart_counts l ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id) = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts p ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id) = p.product_id
UNION
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(add_to_cart_count, 0) AS add_to_cart_count,
    COALESCE(left_in_cart_count, 0) AS left_in_cart_count,
    COALESCE(purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM add_to_cart_counts a
LEFT JOIN view_counts v ON a.product_id = v.product_id
LEFT JOIN left_in_cart_counts l ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id) = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts p ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id) = p.product_id
WHERE v.product_id IS NULL
UNION
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(add_to_cart_count, 0) AS add_to_cart_count,
    COALESCE(left_in_cart_count, 0) AS left_in_cart_count,
    COALESCE(purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM left_in_cart_counts l
LEFT JOIN view_counts v ON l.product_id = v.product_id
LEFT JOIN add_to_cart_counts a ON l.product_id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts p ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id) = p.product_id
WHERE v.product_id IS NULL AND a.product_id IS NULL
UNION
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(add_to_cart_count, 0) AS add_to_cart_count,
    COALESCE(left_in_cart_count, 0) AS left_in_cart_count,
    COALESCE(purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM purchase_counts p
LEFT JOIN view_counts v ON p.product_id = v.product_id
LEFT JOIN add_to_cart_counts a ON p.product_id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN left_in_cart_counts l ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE v.product_id IS NULL AND a.product_id IS NULL AND l.product_id IS NULL
ORDER BY product_id

WITH InterestData AS (
  SELECT
    month_year AS month,
    interest_id AS interest,
    composition / index_value AS avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE month_year >= '2018-09' AND month_year <= '2019-08'
),
MaxInterestPerMonth AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    interest AS max_interest,
    MAX(avg_composition) AS max_index_composition
  FROM InterestData
  GROUP BY month
),
MaxIndexWithRolling AS (
  SELECT
    m1.month,
    m1.max_interest,
    m1.max_index_composition,
    AVG(m2.max_index_composition) OVER(ORDER BY m1.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_max_index_composition
  FROM MaxInterestPerMonth m1
  LEFT JOIN MaxInterestPerMonth m2 ON m2.month <= m1.month
),
MaxInterestPriorMonths AS (
  SELECT
    m.month,
    m.max_interest,
    m.max_index_composition,
    LAG(m.max_interest, 1) OVER(ORDER BY m.month) AS interest_1_month_ago,
    LAG(m.max_index_composition, 1) OVER(ORDER BY m.month) AS max_index_composition_1_month_ago,
    LAG(m.max_interest, 2) OVER(ORDER BY m.month) AS interest_2_month_ago,
    LAG(m.max_index_composition, 2) OVER(ORDER BY m.month) AS max_index_composition_2_month_ago
  FROM MaxInterestPerMonth m
)
SELECT
  m.month AS date,
  m.max_interest AS interest_name,
  m.max_index_composition,
  r.rolling_avg_max_index_composition AS three_month_rolling_avg,
  p.interest_1_month_ago AS interest_1m_ago,
  p.max_index_composition_1_month_ago AS max_index_composition_1m_ago,
  p.interest_2_month_ago AS interest_2m_ago,
  p.max_index_composition_2_month_ago AS max_index_composition_2m_ago
FROM MaxInterestPerMonth m
JOIN MaxIndexWithRolling r ON m.month = r.month
JOIN MaxInterestPriorMonths p ON m.month = p.month
ORDER BY m.month;

WITH RankedCompositions AS (
  SELECT
    month_year AS time,
    interest_id,
    composition,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY composition DESC) AS rank_desc,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY composition ASC) AS rank_asc
  FROM interest_metrics
),
InterestNames AS (
  SELECT id AS interest_id, interest_name
  FROM interest_map
)
SELECT rc.time, im.interest_name, rc.composition
FROM RankedCompositions rc
JOIN InterestNames im ON rc.interest_id = im.interest_id
WHERE rc.rank_desc <= 10 OR rc.rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY rc.composition DESC, rc.time, im.interest_name;

WITH customer_spending_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customerid,
        SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS total_spent
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
    WHERE strftime('%Y', o.orderdate) = '1998'
    GROUP BY o.customerid
),

customer_grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.customerid,
        cs.total_spent,
        cgt.groupname
    FROM customer_spending_1998 cs
    JOIN customergroupthreshold cgt ON cs.total_spent >= cgt.rangebottom AND cs.total_spent < cgt.rangetop
),

customer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        groupname,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count
    FROM customer_grouped
    GROUP BY groupname
),

total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS total_count
    FROM customer_spending_1998
)

SELECT 
    cc.groupname AS customer_group,
    cc.customer_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * cc.customer_count / tc.total_count, 2) AS percentage_of_total
FROM customer_counts cc
CROSS JOIN total_customers tc
ORDER BY cc.groupname;

WITH EmployeeOrderStats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.EmployeeID,
        COUNT(o.OrderID) AS TotalOrders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.ShippedDate >= o.RequiredDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LateOrders
    FROM employees e
    JOIN orders o ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID
    GROUP BY e.EmployeeID
    HAVING TotalOrders > 50
)
SELECT 
    EmployeeID,
    LateOrders,
    ROUND(CAST(LateOrders AS FLOAT) / TotalOrders * 100, 2) AS LateOrderPercentage
FROM EmployeeOrderStats
ORDER BY LateOrderPercentage DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH YearCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(M.year AS INTEGER) AS start_year,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Movie WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN CAST(M.year AS INTEGER) AND CAST(M.year AS INTEGER) + 9) AS film_count
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM Movie) M
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM YearCounts
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ActorFilms AS (
  SELECT 
    M_Cast.PID AS actor_id,
    CAST(Movie.year AS INTEGER) AS film_year
  FROM M_Cast
  JOIN Movie ON M_Cast.MID = Movie.MID
  GROUP BY M_Cast.PID, film_year
),
YearsRange AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    MIN(film_year) AS min_year,
    MAX(film_year) AS max_year
  FROM ActorFilms
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
YearSeries AS (
  SELECT actor_id, min_year + offs AS year
  FROM YearsRange
  JOIN (SELECT 0 AS offs UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20) AS seq
  WHERE min_year + offs <= max_year
),
ActorFilmYears AS (
  SELECT actor_id, film_year FROM ActorFilms
),
CheckedGaps AS (
  SELECT 
    y.actor_id, 
    y.year
  FROM YearSeries y
  LEFT JOIN ActorFilmYears afy ON y.actor_id = afy.actor_id AND y.year = afy.film_year
  GROUP BY y.actor_id, y.year
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN afy.film_year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
    AND (
      NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ActorFilmYears a1 WHERE a1.actor_id = y.actor_id AND a1.film_year BETWEEN y.year AND y.year + 3)
    )
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS actors_without_4_year_gap
FROM YearsRange
WHERE actor_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT actor_id FROM CheckedGaps)

WITH DirectorFilms AS (
    SELECT
        M_Cast.PID AS actor_pid,
        M_Director.PID AS director_pid,
        COUNT(*) AS film_count
    FROM M_Cast
    JOIN Movie ON M_Cast.MID = Movie.MID
    JOIN M_Director ON Movie.MID = M_Director.MID
    GROUP BY M_Cast.PID, M_Director.PID
),
YashChopra AS (
    SELECT PID FROM Person WHERE Name = 'Yash Chopra'
),
YashChopraFilms AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, film_count
    FROM DirectorFilms
    WHERE director_pid = (SELECT PID FROM YashChopra)
),
ActorsMoreWithYashChopra AS (
    SELECT df.actor_pid
    FROM DirectorFilms df
    JOIN YashChopraFilms yf ON df.actor_pid = yf.actor_pid
    WHERE yf.film_count > df.film_count
      AND df.director_pid != (SELECT PID FROM YashChopra)
    GROUP BY df.actor_pid
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DirectorFilms df2 WHERE df2.actor_pid = df.actor_pid AND df2.director_pid != (SELECT PID FROM YashChopra))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS actors_more_films_with_yash_chopra
FROM ActorsMoreWithYashChopra;

WITH EntertainerStylesRanked AS (
    SELECT
        EntertainerID,
        StyleID,
        StyleStrength,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) AS rn
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE StyleStrength <= 3
),
CustomerPrefsRanked AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        StyleID,
        PreferenceSeq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) AS rn
    FROM Musical_Preferences
),
EntertainerStylePairs AS (
    SELECT
        es1.EntertainerID,
        es1.StyleID AS style1,
        es2.StyleID AS style2
    FROM EntertainerStylesRanked es1
    JOIN EntertainerStylesRanked es2
      ON es1.EntertainerID = es2.EntertainerID
     AND es1.rn = 1
     AND es2.rn = 2
),
CustomerPrefPairs AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.StyleID AS style1,
        c2.StyleID AS style2
    FROM CustomerPrefsRanked c
    JOIN CustomerPrefsRanked c2
      ON c.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
     AND c.rn = 1
     AND c2.rn = 2
),
MatchingPairs AS (
    SELECT es.EntertainerID, c.CustomerID
    FROM EntertainerStylePairs es
    JOIN CustomerPrefPairs c
      ON (es.style1 = c.style1 AND es.style2 = c.style2)
         OR (es.style1 = c.style2 AND es.style2 = c.style1)
)
SELECT
    e.EntStageName AS entertainer_stage_name,
    cu.CustLastName AS customer_last_name
FROM MatchingPairs m
JOIN Entertainers e ON m.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers cu ON m.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID
LIMIT 1000;

WITH regional_txns AS (
    SELECT
        bm.region,
        STRFTIME('%Y', bt.txn_date) AS year,
        SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) AS total_dollars,
        SUM(bt.quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.txn_date = bp.market_date
    WHERE bt.txn_type = 'BUY' AND bp.ticker = bt.ticker
    GROUP BY bm.region, year
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM regional_txns r1
    WHERE year > (
        SELECT MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', txn_date))
        FROM bitcoin_transactions bt2
        JOIN bitcoin_members bm2 ON bt2.member_id = bm2.member_id
        WHERE bm2.region = r1.region
    )
),
avg_price AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        year,
        total_dollars / total_quantity AS avg_purchase_price
    FROM filtered_data
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) AS price_rank
    FROM avg_price
),
pct_change AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        price_rank,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (avg_purchase_price - LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year)) / LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year),
            2
        ) AS pct_change_from_prev_year
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT *
FROM pct_change
ORDER BY year, price_rank;

WITH FemaleLegislators AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide
  FROM legislators
  WHERE gender = 'F'
), FemaleTermStates AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.id_bioguide,
    ft.state,
    MIN(ft.term_start) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms ft
  JOIN FemaleLegislators fl ON ft.id_bioguide = fl.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY ft.id_bioguide, ft.state
), FirstStatePerFemale AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, state AS first_state
  FROM (
    SELECT id_bioguide, state, first_term_start,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id_bioguide ORDER BY first_term_start) AS rn
    FROM FemaleTermStates
  ) WHERE rn = 1
), TermsIncludingDec31 AS (
  SELECT l.id_bioguide, f.first_state
  FROM legislators_terms l
  JOIN FirstStatePerFemale f ON l.id_bioguide = f.id_bioguide
  WHERE (
    (strftime('%m-%d', l.term_start) <= '12-31' AND (l.term_end IS NULL OR strftime('%m-%d', l.term_end) >= '12-31'))
  )
)
SELECT first_state AS state_abbreviation, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS female_legislators_count
FROM TermsIncludingDec31
GROUP BY first_state
ORDER BY female_legislators_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

  SELECT job_id
  FROM job_postings_fact
  WHERE job_title = 'Data Analyst'
    AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND job_work_from_home = 1
),
skill_counts AS (

),
top_skills_postings AS (

),
filtered_postings AS (
  SELECT salary_year_avg

  WHERE job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM top_skills_postings)
    AND job_title = 'Data Analyst'
    AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND job_work_from_home = 1
)
SELECT AVG(salary_year_avg) AS overall_avg_salary
FROM filtered_postings
;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  WHERE term_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
term_years AS (
  SELECT c.id_bioguide, c.first_term_start, 
         term_start, term_end
  FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN cohort c ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
),
retention AS (
  SELECT y.year,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cohort.id_bioguide) AS cohort_size,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
           WHEN ty.term_start <= date(cohort.first_term_start, printf('+%d years', y.year)) 
                AND (ty.term_end >= date(cohort.first_term_start, printf('+%d years', y.year)) OR ty.term_end IS NULL)
           THEN cohort.id_bioguide
         END) AS retained_count
  FROM 
    (SELECT 1 AS year UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 
     UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
     UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
     UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20) y
  CROSS JOIN cohort
  LEFT JOIN term_years ty ON ty.id_bioguide = cohort.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY y.year
  ORDER BY y.year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  retained_count * 1.0 / cohort_size AS annual_retention_rate
FROM retention;

WITH la_male_legislators AS (
  SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state, MIN(lt.term_start) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
  GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state
),
active_on_year_end AS (
  SELECT lml.id_bioguide,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', year_ends.end_of_year) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', lml.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) AS years_elapsed
  FROM la_male_legislators lml
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lml.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE(year || '-12-31') AS end_of_year
    FROM (
      SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', term_start) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM legislators_terms
      UNION
      SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', term_end) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM legislators_terms
      WHERE term_end IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE year IS NOT NULL
  ) AS year_ends ON lt.term_start <= year_ends.end_of_year AND (lt.term_end IS NULL OR lt.term_end >= year_ends.end_of_year)
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS distinct_legislators
FROM active_on_year_end
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed;

WITH customer_ltv AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    SUM(amount) AS lifetime_sales,
    MIN(payment_date) AS first_purchase_date
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING lifetime_sales > 0
),
customer_sales_days AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_sales,
    CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= DATETIME(cl.first_purchase_date, '+7 days') THEN SUM(p.amount) ELSE 0 END AS sales_7_days,
    CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= DATETIME(cl.first_purchase_date, '+30 days') THEN SUM(p.amount) ELSE 0 END AS sales_30_days
  FROM payment p
  JOIN customer_ltv cl ON p.customer_id = cl.customer_id
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, p.payment_date
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(sales_7_days) AS sales_7_days,
    MAX(sales_30_days) AS sales_30_days,
    (SELECT lifetime_sales FROM customer_ltv WHERE customer_id = cs.customer_id) AS lifetime_sales
  FROM customer_sales_days cs
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(sales_7_days * 100.0 / lifetime_sales) AS avg_percent_7_days,
  AVG(sales_30_days * 100.0 / lifetime_sales) AS avg_percent_30_days,
  AVG(lifetime_sales) AS avg_lifetime_sales
FROM agg_sales;

WITH film_revenue AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.title, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM film f
  JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
), actors_per_film AS (
  SELECT fa.film_id, fa.actor_id, a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_name
  FROM film_actor fa
  JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
), actor_count_per_film AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
), film_actor_revenue AS (
  SELECT a.film_id, a.actor_id, a.actor_name, fr.title,
         fr.total_revenue, ac.actor_count,
         fr.total_revenue * 1.0 / ac.actor_count AS revenue_per_actor
  FROM actors_per_film a
  JOIN film_revenue fr ON a.film_id = fr.film_id
  JOIN actor_count_per_film ac ON a.film_id = ac.film_id
), ranked_films AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) AS rn
  FROM film_actor_revenue
), top3_films_per_actor AS (
  SELECT film_id, actor_id, actor_name, title, revenue_per_actor
  FROM ranked_films
  WHERE rn <= 3
), avg_revenue_per_actor AS (
  SELECT actor_id, AVG(revenue_per_actor) AS avg_revenue
  FROM top3_films_per_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT t.actor_id, t.actor_name, t.film_id, t.title, t.revenue_per_actor, a.avg_revenue
FROM top3_films_per_actor t
JOIN avg_revenue_per_actor a ON t.actor_id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY t.actor_id, t.revenue_per_actor DESC;

WITH TopActors AS (
    SELECT actor_id
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(film_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
CustomerWithTopActorRentals AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
    FROM customer c
    JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM TopActors)
),
TotalCustomers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customer
),
TotalWithTopActors AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_top_actors FROM CustomerWithTopActorRentals
)
SELECT
    CAST(customers_with_top_actors AS FLOAT) / total_customers * 100 AS percentage_of_customers_renting_top_actor_films
FROM TotalWithTopActors, TotalCustomers
;

WITH FirstRental AS (
    SELECT r.customer_id, r.inventory_id, MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_payment_date
    FROM rental r
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id

),
FirstRentalDetails AS (

    FROM FirstRental fr
    JOIN inventory i ON fr.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
),
FirstRentalWithRating AS (
    SELECT frd.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM FirstRentalDetails frd
    JOIN film f ON frd.film_id = f.film_id
),
CustomerStats AS (
    SELECT r.customer_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
           SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount_spent
    FROM rental r
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY r.customer_id
)
SELECT f.rating,
       AVG(cs.total_amount_spent) AS avg_total_amount_spent_per_customer,
       AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_number_of_subsequent_rentals
FROM FirstRentalWithRating f
JOIN CustomerStats cs ON f.customer_id = cs.customer_id
GROUP BY f.rating
ORDER BY f.rating;

WITH Top10Customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
MonthlyPayments AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS month,
    ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS monthly_amount
  FROM payment
  WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Top10Customers)
  GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
MonthlyDiffs AS (
  SELECT
    m1.customer_id,
    m1.month,
    ROUND(ABS(m1.monthly_amount - m2.monthly_amount), 2) AS diff
  FROM MonthlyPayments m1
  JOIN MonthlyPayments m2
    ON m1.customer_id = m2.customer_id
    AND strftime('%Y-%m', date(m2.month || '-01', '+1 month')) = m1.month
)
SELECT customer_id, month, diff
FROM MonthlyDiffs
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH country_sales AS (
  SELECT c.Country,
         COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS num_customers,
         SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales
  FROM customers c
  JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY c.Country

),
ranked_sales AS (
  SELECT total_sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales) AS row_num,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_rows
  FROM country_sales
)
SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS median_total_sales
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE row_num IN ((total_rows + 1) / 2, (total_rows + 2) / 2);

WITH store_rental_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        s.store_id,
        STRFTIME('%Y', r.rental_date) AS year,

        COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
    FROM rental r
    JOIN staff s ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, year, month
),
max_rentals AS (
    SELECT 
        store_id,
        MAX(total_rentals) AS max_total_rentals
    FROM store_rental_counts
    GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT 
    src.store_id,
    src.year,
    src.month,
    src.total_rentals
FROM store_rental_counts src

WITH TopStates AS (
    SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS population
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY population DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
AlienStats AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        AVG(age) AS avg_age,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS friendly_ratio,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS hostile_ratio
    FROM alien_data
    WHERE state IN (SELECT state FROM TopStates)
    GROUP BY state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_top_states
FROM AlienStats
WHERE friendly_ratio > hostile_ratio AND avg_age > 200;

WITH store_order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.store_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.store_id
),
max_store AS (
  SELECT store_id, total_orders
  FROM store_order_counts
  ORDER BY total_orders DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
store_delivered_counts AS (

    o.store_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 END) AS delivered_orders
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id

)
SELECT

  COALESCE(delivered_orders, 0) AS delivered_orders,
  CASE WHEN s.total_orders > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(delivered_orders, 0) AS FLOAT) / s.total_orders ELSE 0 END AS delivered_ratio

WITH monthly_finished_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.store_id AS hub_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_moment_finished) AS order_month,
    COUNT(*) AS finished_order_count
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'finished'
    AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_moment_finished) IN ('2023-02', '2023-03')
  GROUP BY o.store_id, order_month
)
SELECT 
  fhub.hub_id,
  hb.hub_name,
  fhub.finished_order_count AS finished_orders_february,
  mhub.finished_order_count AS finished_orders_march,
  ((mhub.finished_order_count - fhub.finished_order_count) * 1.0 / fhub.finished_order_count) * 100 AS percent_increase
FROM monthly_finished_orders fhub
JOIN monthly_finished_orders mhub ON fhub.hub_id = mhub.hub_id
JOIN hubs hb ON hb.hub_id = fhub.hub_id
WHERE fhub.order_month = '2023-02'

WITH TrackDurations AS (
  SELECT
    TrackId,
    Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS DurationMin
  FROM Track
),
Stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(DurationMin) AS MinDuration,
    AVG(DurationMin) AS AvgDuration,
    MAX(DurationMin) AS MaxDuration
  FROM TrackDurations
),
Classified AS (
  SELECT
    t.TrackId,
    t.DurationMin,
    CASE
      WHEN t.DurationMin <= (s.MinDuration + s.AvgDuration) / 2 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.DurationMin <= (s.AvgDuration + s.MaxDuration) / 2 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END AS LengthType
  FROM TrackDurations t, Stats s
),
RevenueByTrack AS (
  SELECT
    il.TrackId,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  GROUP BY il.TrackId
),
Summary AS (
  SELECT
    c.LengthType,
    MIN(c.DurationMin) AS MinDuration,
    MAX(c.DurationMin) AS MaxDuration,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.Revenue, 0)) AS TotalRevenue
  FROM Classified c
  LEFT JOIN RevenueByTrack r ON c.TrackId = r.TrackId
  GROUP BY c.LengthType
)
SELECT LengthType, ROUND(MinDuration, 2) AS MinDuration_Minutes, ROUND(MaxDuration, 2) AS MaxDuration_Minutes, ROUND(TotalRevenue, 2) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Summary
ORDER BY CASE LengthType WHEN 'Short' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Long' THEN 3 END
LIMIT 1000;

),
AvgCompanySalaryByCity AS (

Top5CompaniesByCity AS (

),
AvgNationalSalary AS (

)
SELECT

WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        wt.player_out AS out_player_id,
        bb.bowler,
        wt.match_id,
        wt.over_id,
        wt.ball_id
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out != 'run out'
),

bowler_runs_balls AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),

bowler_match_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bw.bowler,
        bw.match_id,
        COUNT(bw.ball_id) AS wickets,
        COALESCE(brb.runs_off_bat, 0) AS runs_conceded,
        COALESCE(brb.balls_bowled, 0) AS balls_bowled
    FROM bowler_wickets bw
    LEFT JOIN bowler_runs_balls brb ON bw.bowler = brb.bowler AND bw.match_id = brb.match_id
    GROUP BY bw.bowler, bw.match_id
),

bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        SUM(wickets) AS total_wickets,
        SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(balls_bowled) AS total_balls_bowled
    FROM bowler_match_stats
    GROUP BY bowler
),

best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, wickets, runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC) AS rn
    FROM bowler_match_stats
),

best_perf AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, wickets, runs_conceded
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
    p.player_id AS bowler_id,
    p.player_name,
    bt.total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN bt.total_balls_bowled > 0 THEN CAST(bt.total_runs_conceded AS FLOAT) / (bt.total_balls_bowled / 6) ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN bt.total_wickets > 0 THEN CAST(bt.total_balls_bowled AS FLOAT) / bt.total_wickets ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
    bp.wickets || '-' || bp.runs_conceded AS best_bowling_performance
FROM bowler_totals bt
JOIN best_perf bp ON bt.bowler = bp.bowler
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bt.bowler
ORDER BY bt.total_wickets DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH PlayerRoles AS (
  SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS role_count
  FROM player_match
  GROUP BY player_id, role
),
MostFrequentRole AS (
  SELECT player_id, role AS most_frequent_role
  FROM (
    SELECT player_id, role, role_count, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY role_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM PlayerRoles
  ) 
  WHERE rn = 1
),
BatsmanRuns AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    over_id,
    ball_id,
    runs_scored
  FROM batsman_scored
),
BallsFaced AS (
  SELECT 
    b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.striker AS player_id
  FROM ball_by_ball b
),
PlayerBattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    bf.player_id,
    SUM(br.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT br.match_id) AS matches_played,
    COUNT(wt.ball_id) AS total_dismissals,
    MAX(br.runs_scored) AS highest_score,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN br.runs_scored >= 30 THEN br.match_id END) AS matches_30_or_more,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN br.runs_scored >= 50 THEN br.match_id END) AS matches_50_or_more,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN br.runs_scored >= 100 THEN br.match_id END) AS matches_100_or_more,
    COUNT(*) AS total_balls_faced
  FROM BallsFaced bf
  LEFT JOIN BatsmanRuns br ON bf.match_id = br.match_id AND bf.over_id = br.over_id AND bf.ball_id = br.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bf.player_id = wt.player_out AND bf.match_id = wt.match_id
  GROUP BY bf.player_id
),
BattingAverage AS (
  SELECT player_id, CASE WHEN total_dismissals = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(total_runs AS FLOAT) / total_dismissals END AS batting_average
  FROM PlayerBattingStats
),
StrikeRate AS (
  SELECT player_id, CASE WHEN total_balls_faced = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (total_runs * 100.0 / total_balls_faced) END AS strike_rate
  FROM PlayerBattingStats
),
BowlingStatsPerBall AS (
  SELECT
    bb.bowler AS player_id,
    bb.match_id,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_off_bat,
    0 AS extras_runs,
    SUM(COALESCE(wt2.player_out IS NOT NULL, 0)) AS wickets_in_ball
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt2 ON bb.match_id = wt2.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt2.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt2.ball_id
  GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.ball_id
),
BowlingStats AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    SUM(wickets_in_ball) AS total_wickets,
    SUM(runs_off_bat) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(balls_bowled) AS balls_bowled
  FROM BowlingStatsPerBall
  GROUP BY player_id
),
EconomyRate AS (
  SELECT player_id, CASE WHEN balls_bowled = 0 THEN NULL ELSE runs_conceded * 6.0 / balls_bowled END AS economy_rate
  FROM BowlingStats
),
BowlingPerformancePerMatch AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    match_id,
    SUM(wickets_in_ball) AS wickets_in_match,
    SUM(runs_off_bat) AS runs_given
  FROM BowlingStatsPerBall
  GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
BestBowlingPerformance AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    MAX(wickets_in_match) AS max_wickets
  FROM BowlingPerformancePerMatch
  GROUP BY player_id
),
BestBowlingRunsGiven AS (
  SELECT
    bp.player_id,
    MIN(bp2.runs_given) AS min_runs_given
  FROM BestBowlingPerformance bp
  JOIN BowlingPerformancePerMatch bp2 ON bp.player_id = bp2.player_id AND bp.max_wickets = bp2.wickets_in_match
  GROUP BY bp.player_id
),
BestBowlingPerformanceFormatted AS (
  SELECT
    bwp.player_id,
    printf('%d-%d', bwp.max_wickets, bbr.min_runs_given) AS best_bowling_performance
  FROM BestBowlingPerformance bwp
  JOIN BestBowlingRunsGiven bbr ON bwp.player_id = bbr.player_id
),
MostFrequentRoleByPlayer AS (
  SELECT player_id, most_frequent_role
  FROM MostFrequentRole
),
PlayersAggregated AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    fr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill
  FROM player p
  LEFT JOIN MostFrequentRoleByPlayer fr ON p.player_id = fr.player_id
)
SELECT
  pa.player_id,
  pa.player_name,
  pa.most_frequent_role,
  pa.batting_hand,
  pa.bowling_skill,
  COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
  COALESCE(pb.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
  COALESCE(pb.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_times_dismissed,
  ba.batting_average,
  COALESCE(pb.highest_score, 0) AS highest_score,
  COALESCE(pb.matches_30_or_more, 0) AS matches_30_or_more,
  COALESCE(pb.matches_50_or_more, 0) AS matches_50_or_more,
  COALESCE(pb.matches_100_or_more, 0) AS matches_100_or_more,
  COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
  sr.strike_rate,
  COALESCE(bs.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
  er.economy_rate,
  bbpf.best_bowling_performance
FROM PlayersAggregated pa
LEFT JOIN PlayerBattingStats pb ON pa.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN BattingAverage ba ON pa.player_id = ba.player_id
LEFT JOIN StrikeRate sr ON pa.player_id = sr.player_id
LEFT JOIN BowlingStats bs ON pa.player_id = bs.player_id
LEFT JOIN EconomyRate er ON pa.player_id = er.player_id
LEFT JOIN BestBowlingPerformanceFormatted bbpf ON pa.player_id = bbpf.player_id
ORDER BY pa.player_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH StepScores AS (
    SELECT
        m.name,
        m.version,
        m.step,
        m.L1_model,
        s.model,
        s.test_score
    FROM model m
    JOIN model_score s ON m.name = s.name AND m.version = s.version AND m.step = s.step
),
MaxScores AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        version,
        step,
        MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_non_stack_test_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) AS stack_test_score
    FROM StepScores
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
ModelStatus AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        version,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN max_non_stack_test_score < stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'strong'
            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN max_non_stack_test_score = stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'soft'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS status
    FROM MaxScores
    GROUP BY name, version
),
L1ModelStatus AS (
    SELECT
        s.name,
        s.version,
        s.L1_model,
        ms.status
    FROM StepScores s
    JOIN ModelStatus ms ON s.name = ms.name AND s.version = ms.version
    WHERE ms.status IS NOT NULL
),
CountByL1ModelStatus AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        L1_model,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM L1ModelStatus
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
MaxCountByStatus AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
    FROM CountByL1ModelStatus
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT
    c.status,
    c.L1_model,
    c.cnt
FROM CountByL1ModelStatus c
JOIN MaxCountByStatus m
ON c.status = m.status AND c.cnt = m.max_cnt
ORDER BY c.status DESC;

WITH model_counts AS (
  SELECT
    L1_model,
    model_type,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM (
    SELECT L1_model, 'traditional' AS model_type FROM model WHERE name NOT LIKE '%Stack%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT L1_model, 'stack' AS model_type FROM model WHERE name LIKE '%Stack%'
  )
  GROUP BY L1_model, model_type
), total_counts AS (
  SELECT L1_model, SUM(count) AS total_count
  FROM model_counts
  GROUP BY L1_model
)
SELECT L1_model, total_count
FROM total_counts
ORDER BY total_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RECURSIVE leaf_items AS (
  -- Start from top-level packaging combinations (all distinct packaging_id)
  SELECT
    pr.packaging_id AS final_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id AS leaf_packaging_id,
    pr.qty AS quantity
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  WHERE pr.contains_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursively expand nested packaging relations
  SELECT
    li.final_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    li.quantity * pr.qty AS quantity
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  JOIN leaf_items li ON pr.packaging_id = li.leaf_packaging_id
),

leaf_quantity_sums AS (
  -- Sum quantities for each final packaging and leaf packaging
  SELECT
    final_packaging_id,
    leaf_packaging_id,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM leaf_items
  GROUP BY final_packaging_id, leaf_packaging_id
),

final_totals AS (
  -- Sum all leaf quantities per final packaging
  SELECT
    final_packaging_id,
    SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity_across_leaves
  FROM leaf_quantity_sums
  GROUP BY final_packaging_id
)

SELECT AVG(total_quantity_across_leaves) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM final_totals;

WITH ordered_picking AS (

        pl.product_id,
        pl.qty,
        p.created
    FROM picking_line pl
    JOIN picking_list p ON pl.picklist_id = p.id
    WHERE pl.order_id = 421
    ORDER BY p.created ASC
),

average_units_fifo AS (

        product_id,
        AVG(qty) AS avg_units_picked
    FROM ordered_picking
    GROUP BY product_id
)

SELECT
    product_id,
    avg_units_picked
FROM average_units_fifo;

WITH monthly_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', orders.ordered) AS year_month,
        orderlines.product_id,
        SUM(orderlines.amount) AS total_sales
    FROM orders
    JOIN orderlines ON orders.id = orderlines.order_id
    WHERE orders.ordered >= '2016-01-01' AND orders.ordered < '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY year_month, orderlines.product_id
),
month_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        product_id,
        total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year_month) AS month_idx
    FROM monthly_sales_agg
),
filtered_months AS (
    SELECT * FROM month_indexed
    WHERE month_idx BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
cma_calculations AS (
    SELECT
        f1.year_month,
        f1.product_id,
        f1.month_idx,
        AVG(f2.total_sales) AS window1_avg,
        AVG(f3.total_sales) AS window2_avg
    FROM filtered_months f1
    LEFT JOIN filtered_months f2 ON f1.product_id = f2.product_id AND f2.month_idx BETWEEN f1.month_idx - 5 AND f1.month_idx + 6
    LEFT JOIN filtered_months f3 ON f1.product_id = f3.product_id AND f3.month_idx BETWEEN f1.month_idx - 6 AND f1.month_idx + 5
    GROUP BY f1.year_month, f1.product_id, f1.month_idx
),
cma_final AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        product_id,
        month_idx,
        (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma,
        total_sales
    FROM cma_calculations
    JOIN filtered_months USING (year_month, product_id, month_idx)
),
sales_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        product_id,
        month_idx,
        total_sales,
        cma,
        CASE WHEN cma = 0 THEN NULL ELSE total_sales / cma END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_final
    WHERE cma IS NOT NULL
),
sales_2017 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM sales_ratio
    WHERE year_month >= '2017-01' AND year_month <= '2017-12'
),
products_above_2_all_months AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM sales_2017
    WHERE sales_to_cma_ratio > 2
    GROUP BY product_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 12
)
SELECT products.id AS product_id, products.name AS product_name
FROM products_above_2_all_months
JOIN products ON products_above_2_all_months.product_id = products.id
ORDER BY products.id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH match_results AS (

    season,
    league_id,
    country_id,
    home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 3
         WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1

  FROM Match
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    season,
    league_id,
    country_id,
    away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 3
         WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1

  FROM Match
),

team_points AS (

    country_id,
    team_api_id,

),

ranked_teams AS (

    total_points,

SELECT
