WITH SellerSales AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price,
    SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS total_quantity
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
  HAVING SUM(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
SellerReviews AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(orv.review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
SellerPackingTimes AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) AS avg_packing_time
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
SellerCategorySales AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS category_quantity
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id, p.product_category_name
),
MaxCategorySales AS (
  SELECT 
    seller_id,
    MAX(category_quantity) AS max_quantity
  FROM SellerCategorySales
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
TopCategoryPerSeller AS (
  SELECT s.seller_id, scs.product_category_name
  FROM MaxCategorySales s
  JOIN SellerCategorySales scs ON s.seller_id = scs.seller_id AND s.max_quantity = scs.category_quantity
),
CategoryNameEnglish AS (
  SELECT pcnt.product_category_name, pcnt.product_category_name_english
  FROM product_category_name_translation pcnt
)
SELECT
  ss.seller_id,
  ss.total_sales,
  ss.avg_item_price,
  sr.avg_review_score,
  spt.avg_packing_time,
  ce.product_category_name_english AS top_category_english
FROM SellerSales ss
LEFT JOIN SellerReviews sr ON ss.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN SellerPackingTimes spt ON ss.seller_id = spt.seller_id
LEFT JOIN TopCategoryPerSeller tcs ON ss.seller_id = tcs.seller_id
LEFT JOIN CategoryNameEnglish ce ON tcs.product_category_name = ce.product_category_name
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH monthly_net AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    DATE(strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date)) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END) AS net_amount
  FROM bitcoin_transactions
  GROUP BY member_id, month
),
monthly_balance AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    month,
    SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly_net
),
growth_rates AS (
  SELECT
    a.member_id,
    a.month,
    a.closing_balance,
    b.closing_balance AS prev_closing_balance,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.closing_balance = 0 OR b.closing_balance IS NULL THEN a.closing_balance * 100
      ELSE (a.closing_balance - b.closing_balance) / b.closing_balance * 100
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM monthly_balance a
  LEFT JOIN monthly_balance b ON a.member_id = b.member_id AND a.month = DATE(b.month, '+1 month')
),
latest_month AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    max(month) AS last_month
  FROM growth_rates
  GROUP BY member_id
),
latest_growth AS (
  SELECT gr.member_id, gr.growth_rate
  FROM growth_rates gr
  JOIN latest_month lm ON gr.member_id = lm.member_id AND gr.month = lm.last_month
)

SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_customers_growth_above_5
FROM latest_growth;

WITH member_daily_balance AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    date(txn_date) AS txn_day,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'buy' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY date(txn_date) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance
  FROM bitcoin_transactions
),
first_day_of_month AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_day) AS month_start
  FROM member_daily_balance
),
balance_on_first_of_month AS (
  SELECT
    f.month_start,
    m.member_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT balance FROM member_daily_balance b WHERE b.member_id = m.member_id AND b.txn_day <= f.month_start ORDER BY b.txn_day DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS balance
  FROM first_day_of_month f
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM bitcoin_transactions) m
),
monthly_total_balance AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END) AS total_balance
  FROM balance_on_first_of_month
  GROUP BY month_start
  ORDER BY month_start
),
previous_month_balance AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    LAG(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_total_balance
  FROM monthly_total_balance
)
SELECT 
  month_start,
  prev_total_balance AS total_balance
FROM previous_month_balance
WHERE prev_total_balance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_start ASC;

WITH customer_daily_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(txn_date) AS transaction_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS daily_net_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, transaction_date
),
customer_running_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    transaction_date,
    SUM(daily_net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance
  FROM customer_daily_balances
),
customer_30day_rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    transaction_date,
    MAX(0, AVG(running_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS rolling_avg_balance
  FROM customer_running_balance
),
monthly_max_30day_avg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', transaction_date) AS year_month,
    MAX(rolling_avg_balance) AS max_rolling_avg_balance
  FROM customer_30day_rolling_avg
  WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) 
         FROM customer_30day_rolling_avg c2 
         WHERE c2.customer_id = customer_30day_rolling_avg.customer_id 
           AND c2.transaction_date <= customer_30day_rolling_avg.transaction_date) >= 30
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),
customer_baseline_month AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', date(txn_date))) AS baseline_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
final_monthly_sums AS (
  SELECT
    mm.year_month,
    SUM(mm.max_rolling_avg_balance) AS sum_max_rolling_avg_balance
  FROM monthly_max_30day_avg mm
  JOIN customer_baseline_month cb ON mm.customer_id = cb.customer_id
  WHERE mm.year_month != cb.baseline_month
  GROUP BY mm.year_month
  ORDER BY mm.year_month
)
SELECT * FROM final_monthly_sums;

WITH daily_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(txn_date) AS date,
    SUM(txn_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date(txn_date) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS raw_balance
  FROM customer_transactions
),
filled_dates AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(min_date, '+' || delta || ' day') AS date
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      MIN(date(txn_date)) AS min_date,
      MAX(date(txn_date)) AS max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
  ),
  (SELECT 0 AS delta UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
   UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
   UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30
   UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40
   UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49 UNION ALL SELECT 50
   UNION ALL SELECT 51 UNION ALL SELECT 52 UNION ALL SELECT 53 UNION ALL SELECT 54 UNION ALL SELECT 55 UNION ALL SELECT 56 UNION ALL SELECT 57 UNION ALL SELECT 58 UNION ALL SELECT 59 UNION ALL SELECT 60) AS days
  WHERE date(min_date, '+' || delta || ' day') <= max_date
),
daily_balances_filled AS (
  SELECT
    fd.customer_id,
    fd.date,
    COALESCE(db.raw_balance, 0) AS raw_balance
  FROM filled_dates fd
  LEFT JOIN daily_balances db ON fd.customer_id = db.customer_id AND fd.date = db.date
),
carried_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date,
    CASE WHEN raw_balance = 0 THEN NULL ELSE raw_balance END AS balance_if_present
  FROM daily_balances_filled
),
carry_forward AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date,
    MAX(balance_if_present) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance
  FROM carried_balances
),
non_negative_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date,
    CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END AS balance
  FROM carry_forward
),
monthly_max_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    MAX(balance) AS max_balance
  FROM non_negative_balances
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', date)
),
monthly_total AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    SUM(max_balance) AS total_max_balance
  FROM monthly_max_balances
  GROUP BY month
  ORDER BY month
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_total;

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', week_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    week_date,
    sales
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    AND (week_date BETWEEN date(year || '-05-18') AND date(year || '-07-13'))
),
segments AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales,
    CASE
      WHEN week_date < date(year || '-06-15') THEN 'before'
      WHEN week_date >= date(year || '-06-15') THEN 'after'
    END AS period
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY year, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
  FROM segments
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
  year,
  sales_before,
  sales_after,
  ROUND(((sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0) / sales_before, 2) AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY year;

WITH sales_periods AS (
  SELECT
    week_date,
    region,
    platform,
    segment,
    customer_type,
    sales
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date BETWEEN date('2020-03-23') AND date('2020-09-07')
),
before_after_sales AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    segment,
    customer_type,
    CASE WHEN week_date < date('2020-06-15') THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_periods
  GROUP BY region, platform, segment, customer_type, period
),
pct_change AS (
  SELECT
    before_sales.region AS region,
    before_sales.platform AS platform,
    before_sales.segment AS segment,
    before_sales.customer_type AS customer_type,
    CASE 
      WHEN before_sales.total_sales = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ((after_sales.total_sales * 1.0 / before_sales.total_sales) - 1) * 100 
    END AS pct_change
  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM before_after_sales WHERE period = 'before') AS before_sales
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM before_after_sales WHERE period = 'after') AS after_sales
    ON before_sales.region = after_sales.region
    AND before_sales.platform = after_sales.platform
    AND before_sales.segment = after_sales.segment
    AND before_sales.customer_type = after_sales.customer_type
),
avg_pct_change_by_region AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM pct_change WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region
),
avg_pct_change_by_platform AS (
  SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM pct_change WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL GROUP BY platform
),
avg_pct_change_by_segment AS (
  SELECT segment, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM pct_change WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL GROUP BY segment
),
avg_pct_change_by_customer_type AS (
  SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM pct_change WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_type
),
avg_pct_change_summary AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attribute_type, AVG(avg_pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM avg_pct_change_by_region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform' AS attribute_type, AVG(avg_pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM avg_pct_change_by_platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'segment' AS attribute_type, AVG(avg_pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM avg_pct_change_by_segment
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type' AS attribute_type, AVG(avg_pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM avg_pct_change_by_customer_type
),
max_negative_impact AS (
  SELECT attribute_type, avg_pct_change
  FROM avg_pct_change_summary
  ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM avg_pct_change_summary
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM max_negative_impact;

WITH driver_year_points AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM results
  GROUP BY race_id, driver_id
),
constructor_year_points AS (
  SELECT race_id, constructor_id, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM results
  GROUP BY race_id, constructor_id
),
race_years AS (
  SELECT race_id, year
  FROM races
),
driver_year_points_with_year AS (
  SELECT r.year, d.driver_id, d.total_points
  FROM driver_year_points d
  JOIN race_years r ON d.race_id = r.race_id
),
constructor_year_points_with_year AS (
  SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.total_points
  FROM constructor_year_points c
  JOIN race_years r ON c.race_id = r.race_id
),
max_driver_points AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM driver_year_points_with_year
  GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor_points AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM constructor_year_points_with_year
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT d.year, (d.max_points + c.max_points) AS combined_points
FROM max_driver_points d
JOIN max_constructor_points c ON d.year = c.year
ORDER BY combined_points ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH ordered_visits AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    action AS page_path,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS visit_order
  FROM access_log
  WHERE action IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
),
seq_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    a.session
  FROM ordered_visits a
  JOIN ordered_visits b ON a.session = b.session
  WHERE a.page_path = '/regist/input'
    AND b.page_path = '/regist/confirm'
    AND a.visit_order < b.visit_order
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS unique_sessions
FROM seq_sessions;

WITH session_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    stamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM activity_log
), landing_pages AS (
  SELECT session, path AS landing_page
  FROM session_ordered
  WHERE rn_asc = 1
), exit_pages AS (
  SELECT session, path AS exit_page
  FROM session_ordered
  WHERE rn_desc = 1
), landing_exit_sessions AS (
  SELECT landing_page AS page, session FROM landing_pages
  UNION
  SELECT exit_page AS page, session FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT page, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS unique_sessions
FROM landing_exit_sessions
GROUP BY page
ORDER BY unique_sessions DESC;

WITH ordered_visits AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    stamp,
    path,
    LEAD(path, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS next_page1,
    LEAD(path, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS next_page2
  FROM activity_log
),

consecutive_detail_third_page AS (
  SELECT
    next_page2 AS third_page
  FROM ordered_visits
  WHERE path = '/detail'
    AND next_page1 = '/detail'
    AND next_page2 IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
  third_page,
  COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM consecutive_detail_third_page
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY visit_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH valid_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id
  FROM pit_stops
),
lap_pos AS (
  SELECT
    race_id,
    driver_id,
    lap,
    position,
    LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS position_prev
  FROM lap_positions
  WHERE race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM valid_races)
),
possible_overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    current.race_id,
    current.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    competitors.driver_id AS overtaken_driver,
    current.lap,
    current.position_prev AS overtaking_prev_pos,
    current.position AS overtaking_pos,
    competitors.position_prev AS overtaken_prev_pos,
    competitors.position AS overtaken_pos
  FROM lap_pos current
  JOIN lap_pos competitors ON current.race_id = competitors.race_id AND current.lap = competitors.lap
  WHERE 
    current.position_prev IS NOT NULL AND competitors.position_prev IS NOT NULL
    AND current.position_prev < current.position
    AND current.position_prev < competitors.position_prev
    AND current.position > competitors.position
),
retired AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM retirements
),
pit_entry AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM pit_stops
),
start_grid AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, position AS grid_position FROM qualifying
),
classified_overtakes AS (
  SELECT 
    p.race_id, p.lap, p.overtaking_driver, p.overtaken_driver,
    CASE
      WHEN r.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND r.lap = p.lap THEN 'R'
      WHEN pe.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND pe.lap = p.lap THEN 'P'
      WHEN po.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND po.lap = p.lap - 1 THEN 'P'
      WHEN p.lap = 1 AND ABS(s_o.grid_position - s_t.grid_position) <= 2 THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS overtake_type
  FROM possible_overtakes p
  LEFT JOIN retired r ON p.race_id = r.race_id AND p.overtaken_driver = r.driver_id AND p.lap = r.lap
  LEFT JOIN pit_entry pe ON p.race_id = pe.race_id AND p.overtaken_driver = pe.driver_id AND p.lap = pe.lap
  LEFT JOIN pit_entry po ON p.race_id = po.race_id AND p.overtaken_driver = po.driver_id AND po.lap = p.lap - 1
  LEFT JOIN start_grid s_o ON p.race_id = s_o.race_id AND p.overtaking_driver = s_o.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN start_grid s_t ON p.race_id = s_t.race_id AND p.overtaken_driver = s_t.driver_id
)
SELECT overtake_type, COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM classified_overtakes
GROUP BY overtake_type
ORDER BY overtake_type;

WITH driver_year_missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        d.driver_id,
        r.year,
        MIN(r.round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(r.round) AS last_missed_round,
        COUNT(*) AS missed_count
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE res.position IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.driver_id, r.year
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
),
drivers_switched_around_misses AS (
    SELECT
        dymr.driver_id,
        dymr.year,
        dymr.first_missed_round,
        dymr.last_missed_round
    FROM driver_year_missed_races dymr
    JOIN races r_before ON r_before.year = dymr.year AND r_before.round = dymr.first_missed_round - 1
    JOIN races r_after ON r_after.year = dymr.year AND r_after.round = dymr.last_missed_round + 1
    JOIN results res_before ON res_before.driver_id = dymr.driver_id AND res_before.race_id = r_before.race_id
    JOIN results res_after ON res_after.driver_id = dymr.driver_id AND res_after.race_id = r_after.race_id
    WHERE res_before.constructor_id <> res_after.constructor_id
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(first_missed_round) AS avg_first_missed_round,
        AVG(last_missed_round) AS avg_last_missed_round
    FROM drivers_switched_around_misses
)
SELECT avg_first_missed_round, avg_last_missed_round FROM averages;

WITH position_changes AS (
  SELECT
    race_id,
    driver_id,
    lap,
    position AS current_position,
    LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS previous_position
  FROM lap_positions
),
filtered_position_changes AS (
  SELECT pc.*
  FROM position_changes pc
  WHERE pc.lap > 1 -- exclude first lap
),
non_pit_retire_changes AS (
  SELECT fpc.*
  FROM filtered_position_changes fpc
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps ON fpc.race_id = ps.race_id AND fpc.driver_id = ps.driver_id AND fpc.lap = ps.lap
  LEFT JOIN retirements rt ON fpc.race_id = rt.race_id AND fpc.driver_id = rt.driver_id AND fpc.lap = rt.lap
  WHERE ps.lap IS NULL AND rt.lap IS NULL
),
pos_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    driver_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN previous_position > current_position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtaken_others,
    SUM(CASE WHEN previous_position < current_position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtaken_by_others
  FROM non_pit_retire_changes
  WHERE previous_position IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driver_id
),
drivers_overtaken_more AS (
  SELECT driver_id
  FROM pos_changes
  WHERE overtaken_by_others > overtaken_others
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN drivers_overtaken_more dom ON d.driver_id = dom.driver_id
ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

WITH first_action AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(CASE 
      WHEN path = '/detail' OR path = '/complete' THEN stamp 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) AS first_click_or_conversion_time
  FROM activity_log
  GROUP BY session
),

count_pre_events AS (
  SELECT
    a.session,
    COUNT(*) AS pre_event_count
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN first_action f ON a.session = f.session
  WHERE a.stamp < f.first_click_or_conversion_time
    AND a.search_type IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(a.search_type) != ''
  GROUP BY a.session
),

min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) AS min_pre_event_count FROM count_pre_events
),

sessions_min_count AS (
  SELECT session FROM count_pre_events c
  JOIN min_count m ON c.pre_event_count = m.min_pre_event_count
)

SELECT a.session, a.path, a.search_type
FROM activity_log a
JOIN sessions_min_count s ON a.session = s.session
WHERE a.search_type IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(a.search_type) != ''
ORDER BY a.session, a.stamp
LIMIT 1000
;
